language_task: Pick up the block and place it on the cardboard.
outcome_evidence: The green block starts beside the cardboard (frame 0, camera_high). The right gripper approaches and closes beside the block without lifting it (frames 267–330, camera_wrist_right and camera_high), then reopens. At frame 749, camera_high still shows the block off the cardboard, while camera_wrist_right shows the open gripper near it. Placement is not completed; a failed acquisition is visible, although later alignment remains unfinished.

failure_annotations.explanation: By frame 293, camera_wrist_right shows the fingers closed beside rather than around the green block. Through frames 310–350, the block remains outside the closed fingers, and camera_high shows no pickup or transport toward the cardboard. The unsuccessful closed-gripper interval ends when the fingers begin reopening at frame 358.
failure_annotations.recovery: Reopen the fingers, center them on opposite sides of the block at an appropriate height, and close before performing a small verification lift; no human intervention is visibly needed.
failure_annotations.severity_evidence: The attempt fails to acquire the block; camera_high and camera_wrist_right show no damage, fallen objects, or meaningful damage risk.
failure_annotations.resetability_evidence: The block remains accessible on the tabletop and the cardboard remains in place, so another aligned grasp can be attempted without environmental reset or human intervention.
